parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 99. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RestoreType
parameters.description:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

*   **ECS_FILE**: Elastic Compute Service (ECS) files
*   **OSS**: Object Storage Service (OSS) buckets
*   **NAS**: Apsara File Storage NAS file systems
*   **OTS_TABLE**: Tablestore instances
*   **UDM_ECS_ROLLBACK**: ECS instances

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbr describe-restore-jobs-2 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --restore-type ECS_FILE --filters '[{"Operator":"IN","Values":["v-000000000000000000000"],"Key":"VaultId"}]' --edition STANDARD --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun hbr DescribeRestoreJobs2 --region cn-hangzhou --Filters.1.Key VaultId --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --Filters.1.Operator IN --Filters.1.Values.1 'v-000000000000000000000' --RestoreType ECS_FILE --Edition STANDARD
